name: spanish-narrative-must-be-refused
description: The same failure mode as narrative-must-be-refused, written in Spanish by a student who answered in Spanish. It exists because the lint read only English for most of the product's life, which meant this exact narrative shipped clean. Every banned claim here is spelled with its accents, so the fixture also proves the fold end to end rather than in a unit test.
